title: Ice Climber (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

widgets.text: Break through the floor above and jump up. The screen scrolls up as you climb; falling off the bottom costs a life.
Topi push ice blocks to fill holes: hit them with the hammer. Nitpicker birds swoop: hit them when they dive. Polar bears jump to scroll the screen.
32 mountains, each 8 floors plus a bonus stage at the top with vegetables and the condor.
Each mountain's bonus stage has one vegetable kind (eggplant, carrot, cabbage, cucumber, corn...); every one you grab before the timer runs out adds points.
Catch the condor's legs at the very top of the bonus stage for the big bonus. Topi, birds and ice blocks broken also count toward the tally.
Clear the mountain by reaching the bonus stage; the next mountain starts after the tally.
